exclusions.what: T2 BCVA (LogMAR) rows Baseline, 1 month, 3 months and 6 months (R2-R5), early, mid-stage and delayed groups (C2-C4)
exclusions.reason: Complete-case set (protocol inclusion 5; brief ruling on complete-case statements): inclusion criterion (4) required a minimum follow-up of six months, equal to the last tabulated visit (6 months), and incomplete records or insufficient follow-up were an exclusion criterion; the article does not state that every treated eye completed the follow-up. No admissible series remains.

exclusions.what: T2 row '≥15 ETDRS letter improvement n(%)' (R6)

exclusions.reason: Baseline only, of the same complete-case set.

exclusions.what: T3 CMT, T4 recurrence and injection numbers, T5 regression coefficients; F and p-value columns
exclusions.reason: Retinal thickness, injection counts, test statistics and regression coefficients are not extracted.

notes: BCVA was assessed with the ETDRS chart and converted to logMAR (Methods); follow-up times were counted from the first injection.
Groups are defined by the interval from diagnosis to the first injection, before treatment.
